section_summary.extract_value: This section details the methodology of a single study. Participants included 212 university students (91 Latino, 121 East Asian) recruited from a larger study at the University of California, Irvine, with a mean age of 20.89 years (SD=3.07). The measures section describes various scales used, including the Gratitude Questionnaire—Six-Item Form and the 20-item UCLA Loneliness Scale, along with their respective Cronbach's alphas for Latino and East Asian groups.
